annotations.title: Screen up to 25 names against EU sanctions (paid)

description: Bulk sanctions screening (AML/KYC/KYB) of up to 25 person or organisation names per call (0.0012 USDC per name) against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, refreshed weekly. Fuzzy matching handles spelling variants and word order; per name: possible match flag, top score and up to 3 scored matches with EU reference and programmes. For customer onboarding, payouts, vendor and payment screening agents. Costs $0.03 USDC via x402, or one unit of a Factline API key quota.

names.description: 1 to 25 names separated by ';', e.g. 'Vladimir Putin; Wagner Group'
